main_text.l: quæ includo semicirculo, hoc modo:
Centum igitur libræ ceræ emuntur 19
aureis, & 6 albis.
Probatio Aureæ Regulæ fit per inversionem.
Colloco tertium numerum primo
loco, ac numerum Regula Detri inventum,
medio, & primum numerum loco tertio:
Et si per operationem Regulæ, numerus
in medio supra locatus redierit, bene ope-
ratus sum.
lib. aurei alb. lib.
Hic aureos in medio positos duco in al-
bos per 26, inquiens: sexies 9 sunt 54, 4
subnoto, & ƒ mente reservo, ac pergo dicens:
semel 6 sunt 6, quibus addo 5, & sunt 11, quæ
subscribo.
Deinde dico bis novena sunt 18, 8 scribo,
1 mente reservo, ac progredior dicens: se-
mel 2 sunt 2, quibus addo 1, & sunt 3. Nunc
producto subjicio 6 supra in medio positra,
dicens: 6 & 4 sunt 10, subnoto o, servans 1.

page.notes: Hard-to-read or doubtful: the diagram symbols in the first lines are rendered as approximations of printed signs; "ƒ" in "& ƒ mente" is a long-s-like form as printed and may be a printer's abbreviation for "s" (sed/si); "positra" in the last paragraph is a probable printing error for "posita"; the final line is cut off at the page edge ("servans 1" with a trailing mark). Figures in the diagram and the arithmetic rows were transcribed as printed and could not all be verified letter by letter. Right of the number "385" is a stray mark, not text.
